section_summary.extract_value: This section reports a structural equation model tested in a single study (N = 249) examining links among caregiver eating messages, attachment, perfectionism, body appreciation, depressive symptoms, and intuitive eating. The original model fit was good (CFI = .98, SRMR = .04, RMSEA = .05); nonsignificant paths were trimmed, and one modification (attachment anxiety → order perfectionism) was added, yielding a final model with improved fit (CFI = .99, SRMR = .04, RMSEA = .03). The final model accounted for sizable variance in key outcomes (e.g., 40.5% of variance in body appreciation; 44.4% in intuitive eating).
section_summary.evidence_source: Examples from text: 'The structural model in Fig. 1 provided a good fit to the data (CFI=.98, SRMR=.04, RMSEA = .05), χ^2 (20, N = 249) = 30.61, p = .060.'; 'This revised model (CFI=.99, SRMR=.04, RMSEA=.03), χ^2 (27, N=249)=31.74, p=.242 provided a significantly better fit than the trimmed model...'; 'Notably, a sizable percentage of variance (40.5%) in body appreciation was accounted for by restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages, attachment anxiety, discrepancy perfectionism, and order perfectionism.'
